The tees are in a slightly different spot, the pins are moved around, the wind is usually different, etc.

As in most cases, people need to have some type of monetary motivation and they create side games for cash or play tournaments for cash prizes. Golf is a gentlemen (and ladies now) game. You take your time, act in general kindness to other players, have an order to follow when playing. It just creates a nice, relaxing setting for you to enjoy for a few hours a day.
